version.description: Buy a baguette of bread in a Parisian bakery
phrases: Hello Sir, what can I do for you?
I would like a baguette of bread
Here is your baguette of bread, and with this would you like anything else.
Yes I would like two croissants please.
That will be 4 euros and 10 cents. Would you like to pay in cash or by card?
The customer pays with their card.
Have a nice day, see you tomorrow
